significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish both a form-(iii) relation—“benign context-complexity, not raw prompt length, inflates reasoning compute on matched targets at equal accuracy”—and a form-(ii) mechanism in which contamination of a “pre-generation difficulty representation” causally contributes to that inflation and resetting it cancels the tax. This would predict increased difficulty readout and wasted tokens as irrelevant-context complexity rises, explain why isolated-question evaluations misestimate deployed compute, and constrain adaptive-compute accounts such as those motivated by Snell et al.'s test-time-compute scaling work and Muennighoff et al.'s s1 budget-forcing results. The claims are determinate; a negative result would rule out complexity rather than length, or the difficulty representation rather than attention diversion, although rejection of the entire composite would not exclude every source of context-induced overthinking. The topic-substitution check lowers no credit: deleting the specific benign-context contamination law and causal reset leaves only generic mechanistic compute allocation, which would not warrant this score.

reach.justification: The named handles are “prompt sanitation” and an “inference-time difficulty-reset controller,” with the controller acting ex ante at problem onset and therefore leaving an action window before excess reasoning tokens are generated. After per-model re-extraction, the substantive conclusion still predicts a monotone context-complexity-to-difficulty/readout-to-compute relation rather than merely supplying a search procedure, while the exact steering direction may require recalibration. The asserted scope spans reasoning-model scales, math and science tasks, and “realistic RAG-retrieved irrelevant passages,” giving downstream use to RAG and chat-system practitioners who audit latency, gate contexts, or ship inference controls. The topic-substitution check passes: generic efficient-reasoning interpretability supplies neither this pre-generation context screen nor a controller targeted specifically at benign-context contamination.
